BasicNative.description: One of the mod's DLLs, as the Overhaul setup form sets it.
BasicNative.title: BasicNative

Choice.description: One entry of a filter drop-down: the value it filters by ("" for all) and its label.
Choice.title: Choice

FileRead.description:
A file as read: the text exactly (line breaks as \n) and what writing it back needs. The client builds the
form from the text (services.mod_configs.parse_doc).
FileRead.title: FileRead

ModConfigsState.description: The page's snapshot: the profile it was read for ("" when there is none) and its mods with settings files.
ModConfigsState.title: ModConfigsState

ModNode.description:
One mod with settings files. key: stable across reads (seamless, or kind:path); target: what a file is attached
to (a DLL, or a package's folder); loaded: Seamless only: the profile loads it.
ModNode.title: ModNode

Names.description: The four folder names; None leaves one as it is.
Names.title: Names

NoticeAction.description:
key: what the window runs (update | download | notes | skip | restart | later | again | releases | details);
url: for the keys that open a page.
NoticeAction.title: NoticeAction

PlanOffer.description:
A plan operation's answer: a question to show (prompt: kind confirm | pick | choose, plus its words) and the
plan_id to answer on POST /v1/plans/{plan_id}; or, with plan_id null, a refusal (kind refusal: title and body).
PlanOffer.title: PlanOffer

SavesState.description: The page's facts. The presenter (views.saves) words them; which save the profile plays on is the host's.
SavesState.title: SavesState

ScalingSpec.description: The difficulty keys one Seamless Co-op flavour uses, their labels, and the presets offered for them.
ScalingSpec.title: ScalingSpec

SettingSpec.description: One setting a client may change: its kind decides which values are allowed, its scope where it is stored.
SettingSpec.title: SettingSpec

get.description: Ordered job events. `id` is the seq, `event` the type. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to continue.

post.description: Ask the job to stop (it ends with a `cancelled` event). Idempotent: a job that is over just reports its state.
Answer a plan the client was offered: runs it once. Errors: unknown_plan, plan_expired, plan_stale.
Answer a question a running job or the Launch flow asked (a `prompt` event). Error: unknown_prompt.
